units.zh: 耶律屋質耶律吼
units.en: Yelu Wuzhi and Yelu Hou
units.literal: Yelu Wuzhi, Yelu Hou

units.zh: 〈（何魯不）〉
units.en: (Helubu)
units.literal: (Helubu)

units.zh: 耶律安摶耶律窪耶律頹昱耶律撻烈
units.en: Yelu Antuan, Yelu Wa, Yelu Tuiyu, and Yelu Talie
units.literal: Yelu Antuan, Yelu Wa, Yelu Tuiyu, Yelu Talie

units.zh: 耶律屋質，字敵輦，系出孟父房。
units.en: Yelu Wuzhi, whose courtesy name was Dirilian, came from the Mengfu branch of the imperial clan.
units.literal: Yelu Wuzhi, courtesy name Dirilian, was of the Mengfu branch lineage.

units.zh: 姿簡靜，有器識，重然諾。
units.en: He was plain and composed in manner, possessed foresight and judgment, and held his promises sacred.
units.literal: His bearing was simple and calm; he had capacity and insight, and valued his word.

units.zh: 遇事造次，處之從容，人莫能測。
units.en: Even when events struck suddenly, he met them with unhurried ease, and none could read his mind.
units.literal: When affairs arose in haste, he handled them with composure, and no one could fathom him.

units.zh: 博學，知天文。
units.en: He was widely learned and versed in astronomy.
units.literal: He was broadly learned and understood astronomy.

units.zh: 會同間，為惕隱。
units.en: During the Huitong period he held the office of tiyin.
units.literal: During the Huitong era, he served as tiyin.

units.zh: 太宗崩，諸大臣立世宗，太后聞之，怒甚，遣皇子李胡以兵逆擊，遇安端、劉哥等於泰德泉，敗歸。
units.en: After Emperor Taizong died, the senior ministers enthroned Emperor Shizong. When the empress dowager heard of this she was furious and sent the prince Li Hu with an army to oppose them; at Taidede Spring he met Anduan, Liuge, and their forces, was defeated, and withdrew.
units.literal: When Taizong died, the great ministers enthroned Shizong. The empress dowager heard of it and was furious; she sent the prince Li Hu with troops to strike back, met Anduan, Liuge, and others at Taidede Spring, and was defeated and returned.

units.zh: 李胡盡執世宗臣僚家屬，謂守者曰：「我戰不克，先殪此曹！」
units.en: Li Hu seized the families of all of Shizong's ministers and officials and told the guards, "If I cannot win this fight, I will kill every one of them first!"
units.literal: Li Hu seized all the families of Shizong's ministers and officials and said to the guards, "If I cannot win the battle, I will slaughter these people first!"

units.zh: 人皆恟渙相謂曰：「若果戰，則是父子兄弟相夷矣！」
units.en: Everyone was thrown into alarm and said to one another, "If they truly go to war, fathers and sons and brothers will slaughter one another!"
units.literal: Everyone panicked and said to one another, "If they really fight, fathers and sons and brothers will destroy one another!"

units.zh: 軍次潢河橫渡，隔岸相拒。
units.en: The two armies halted at Huanghe Ford Crossing and stood opposed on opposite banks.
units.literal: The armies halted at Huanghe Ford Crossing and faced one another across the river.

units.zh: 時屋質從太后，世宗以屋質善籌，欲行間，乃設事奉書，以試太后。
units.en: Wuzhi was then with the empress dowager. Shizong knew that Wuzhi was adept at strategy and wished to drive a wedge between them, so he fabricated a pretext and sent a letter to probe the empress dowager.
units.literal: At that time Wuzhi was with the empress dowager. Shizong, knowing Wuzhi was skilled at planning, wished to sow discord and therefore contrived an affair and sent a letter to test the empress dowager.

units.zh: 太后得書，以示屋質。
units.en: When the empress dowager received the letter she showed it to Wuzhi.
units.literal: The empress dowager received the letter and showed it to Wuzhi.

units.zh: 屋質讀竟，言曰：「太后佐太祖定天下，故臣願竭死力。
units.en: After reading it through, Wuzhi said, "Your Majesty aided Taizu in bringing the realm under rule, and your servant is ready to give his life in your service.
units.literal: When Wuzhi had finished reading, he said, "The empress dowager aided Taizu in settling the realm, and therefore your servant is willing to exhaust his strength unto death.

units.zh: 若太后見疑，臣雖欲盡忠，得乎？
units.en: But if Your Majesty suspects me, how can I serve you with full loyalty?
units.literal: If the empress dowager suspects me, though I wish to be wholly loyal, can I?

units.zh: 為今之計，莫若以言和解，事必有成；
units.en: The best course now is to seek a settlement through negotiation—success is certain;
units.literal: For the present plan, nothing is better than to seek reconciliation by words—the affair is sure to succeed;

units.zh: 否即宜速戰，以決勝負。
units.en: otherwise you should fight at once and settle the issue by force.
units.literal: otherwise one should fight swiftly to decide victory and defeat.

units.zh: 然人心一搖，國禍不淺，惟太后裁察。」
units.en: Yet once hearts waver, the harm to the state will be grave—may Your Majesty weigh this carefully."
units.literal: Yet if hearts waver once, the state's calamity will not be slight—may the empress dowager judge."

units.zh: 太后曰：「我若疑卿，安肯以書示汝？」
units.en: The empress dowager said, "If I doubted you, why would I show you this letter at all?"
units.literal: The empress dowager said, "If I suspected you, how would I be willing to show you the letter?"

units.zh: 屋質對曰：「李胡、永康王皆太祖子孫，神器非移他族，何不可之有？
units.en: Wuzhi replied, "Li Hu and Prince Yongkang are both Taizu's descendants; the throne will not pass outside the clan—what objection can there be?
units.literal: Wuzhi replied, "Li Hu and Prince Yongkang are both descendants of Taizu; the imperial regalia will not pass to another clan—what could not be allowed?

units.zh: 太后宜思長策，與永康王和議。」
units.en: Your Majesty should think of a lasting settlement and negotiate peace with Prince Yongkang."
units.literal: The empress dowager should consider a long-term plan and enter peace talks with Prince Yongkang."

units.zh: 太后曰：「誰可遣者？」
units.en: The empress dowager asked, "Whom can I send?"
units.literal: The empress dowager said, "Who can be sent?"

units.zh: 對曰：「太后不疑臣，臣請往。
units.en: He said, "If Your Majesty does not doubt me, I ask to go myself.
units.literal: He replied, "If the empress dowager does not doubt your servant, your servant requests to go.

units.zh: 萬一永康王見聽，廟社之福。」
units.en: If Prince Yongkang should listen, it will be a blessing for the realm."
units.literal: If by chance Prince Yongkang heeds me, it will be the blessing of the altars of state."

units.zh: 太后乃遣屋質授書於帝。
units.en: The empress dowager then sent Wuzhi to bear her letter to the emperor.
units.literal: The empress dowager then sent Wuzhi to deliver the letter to the emperor.

units.zh: 帝遣宣徽使耶律海思復書，辭多不遜。
units.en: The emperor sent Yelu Haishi, Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat, to reply with a letter whose tone was largely defiant.
units.literal: The emperor sent the Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat Yelu Haishi to reply; the wording was largely disrespectful.

units.zh: 屋質諫曰：「書意如此，國家之憂未艾也。
units.en: Wuzhi admonished him, saying, "With a reply like this, the realm's troubles are far from over.
units.literal: Wuzhi remonstrated, saying, "With the letter's intent thus, the state's troubles are not yet ended.

units.zh: 能釋怨以安社稷，則臣以為莫若和好。」
units.en: If you can lay aside grievance to secure the state, I believe nothing is better than reconciliation."
units.literal: If one can release resentment to settle the altars of soil and grain, then your servant thinks nothing is better than peace."

units.zh: 帝曰：「彼眾烏合，安能敵我？」
units.en: The emperor said, "Their force is a rabble thrown together—how can they stand against us?"
units.literal: The emperor said, "Their host is a mob gathered in a day—how can they match us?"

units.zh: 屋質曰：「即不敵，奈骨肉何！
units.en: Wuzhi said, "Even if they cannot match us, what of your own kin!
units.literal: Wuzhi said, "Even if they cannot match us, what of flesh and blood!

units.zh: 況未知孰勝。
units.en: Besides, no one yet knows who will prevail.
units.literal: Moreover, it is not yet known who will win.

units.zh: 借曰幸勝，諸臣之族執於李胡者，無噍類矣。
units.en: Even supposing you win, the families of your ministers held by Li Hu will be wiped out to the last soul.
units.literal: Suppose by luck you win—the clans of the ministers held by Li Hu will not have a single survivor.

units.zh: 以此計之，惟和為善。」
units.en: Weighing the matter thus, peace alone is the wise course."
units.literal: Weighing it thus, only peace is good."

units.zh: 左右聞者失色。
units.en: Those standing nearby turned pale at his words.
units.literal: Those at his side who heard turned pale.

units.zh: 帝良久，問曰：「若何而和？」
units.en: After a long silence the emperor asked, "How then can peace be achieved?"
units.literal: After a long while the emperor asked, "How then is peace to be made?"

units.zh: 屋質對曰：「與太后相見，各紓忿恚，和之不難；
units.en: Wuzhi answered, "Meet the empress dowager in person; once each side vents its anger, reconciliation will not be difficult;
units.literal: Wuzhi replied, "Meet the empress dowager face to face; each will ease resentment and anger—peace will not be hard;

units.zh: 不然，決戰非晚。」
units.en: otherwise a decisive battle can still be fought in due time."
units.literal: otherwise decisive battle is not too late."

units.zh: 帝然之，遂遣海思詣太后約和。
units.en: The emperor agreed and sent Haishi to the empress dowager to negotiate terms.
units.literal: The emperor approved and thereupon sent Haishi to the empress dowager to arrange peace.

units.zh: 往返數日，議乃定。
units.en: After several days of exchanges the terms were settled.
units.literal: After several days of going back and forth, the agreement was settled.

units.zh: 始相見，怨言交讓，殊無和意。
units.en: At their first meeting they traded grievances and reproaches, with no sign of reconciliation.
units.literal: When they first met, grievances were exchanged in mutual reproach, and there was no thought of peace at all.

units.zh: 太后謂屋質曰：「汝當為我畫之。」
units.en: The empress dowager said to Wuzhi, "You must work this out for me."
units.literal: The empress dowager said to Wuzhi, "You must plan this for me."

units.zh: 屋質進曰：「太后與大王若能釋怨，臣乃敢進說。」
units.en: Wuzhi stepped forward and said, "If Your Majesty and the great king can lay aside your grievances, only then dare I speak."
units.literal: Wuzhi advanced and said, "If the empress dowager and the great king can release resentment, your servant then dares to offer counsel."

units.zh: 太后曰：「汝第言之。」
units.en: The empress dowager said, "Speak freely."
units.literal: The empress dowager said, "Speak on."

units.zh: 屋質借謁者籌執之，謂太后曰：「昔人皇王在，何故立嗣聖？」
units.en: Wuzhi took a counting stick from an attendant and, holding it, asked the empress dowager, "When Emperor Ren was still alive, why did you enthrone Emperor Sisheng?"
units.literal: Wuzhi borrowed a tally-stick from an attendant and held it, and said to the empress dowager, "In the past, when Emperor Ren was alive, why was Emperor Sishheng enthroned?"

units.zh: 太后曰：「立嗣聖者，太祖遺旨。」
units.en: The empress dowager said, "Enthroning Sishheng was Taizu's final command."
units.literal: The empress dowager said, "Enthroning Sishheng was Taizu's dying command."

units.zh: 又曰：「大王何故擅立，不稟尊親？」
units.en: He went on, "Why did the great king enthrone himself without consulting his mother?"
units.literal: He said again, "Why did the great king enthrone himself on his own authority without reporting to his honored parent?"

units.zh: 帝曰：「人皇王當立而不立，所以去之。」
units.en: The emperor said, "Emperor Ren should have been enthroned but was not—that is why I removed him."
units.literal: The emperor said, "Emperor Ren ought to have been enthroned but was not, and therefore I removed him."

units.zh: 屋質正色曰：「人皇王舍父母之國而奔唐，子道當如是耶？
units.en: Wuzhi said sternly, "Emperor Ren abandoned his parents' realm and fled to Tang—is that how a son should behave?
units.literal: Wuzhi said with stern countenance, "Emperor Ren abandoned his parents' state and fled to Tang—is filial conduct supposed to be like this?

units.zh: 大王見太后，不少遜謝，惟怨是尋。
units.en: When the great king met the empress dowager he showed little deference or apology and nursed only resentment.
units.literal: The great king, on meeting the empress dowager, offered little deference or apology and sought only grievance.

units.zh: 太后牽於偏愛，托先帝遺命，妄授神器。
units.en: The empress dowager, swayed by partial love, invoked the late emperor's dying command and rashly bestowed the throne.
units.literal: The empress dowager, constrained by partial affection, relied on the late emperor's dying command and rashly bestowed the regalia of state.

units.zh: 如此何敢望和，當速交戰！」
units.en: With matters standing thus, how can you hope for peace—you should fight at once!"
units.literal: With matters thus, how dare one hope for peace—one should fight at once!"

units.zh: 擲籌而退。
units.en: He threw down the stick and withdrew.
units.literal: He cast down the tally-stick and withdrew.

units.zh: 太后泣曰：「向太祖遭諸弟亂，天下荼毒，瘡痍未復，庸可再乎！」
units.en: The empress dowager wept and said, "When Taizu was alive his younger brothers brought chaos upon the realm; the land was ravaged and its wounds have not healed—how can we endure this again!"
units.literal: The empress dowager wept and said, "Formerly Taizu suffered disorder from his younger brothers; the realm was ravaged and its wounds are not yet healed—how could this happen again!"

units.zh: 乃索籌一。
units.en: She then asked for a counting stick.
units.literal: She then asked for one tally-stick.

units.zh: 帝曰：「父不為而子為，又誰咎也！」
units.en: The emperor said, "What the father failed to do, the son has done—whom else is there to blame!"
units.literal: The emperor said, "What the father did not do, the son did—whom else is there to blame!"

units.zh: 亦取籌而執。
units.en: He too took a stick and held it.
units.literal: He too took a tally-stick and held it.

units.zh: 左右感激，大慟。
units.en: Those standing by were deeply moved and wept aloud.
units.literal: Those at hand were deeply moved and wept loudly.

units.zh: 太后復謂屋質曰：「議既定，神器竟誰歸？」
units.en: The empress dowager again asked Wuzhi, "Now that peace is settled, to whom will the throne ultimately pass?"
units.literal: The empress dowager again said to Wuzhi, "Now that the agreement is settled, to whom will the regalia of state ultimately go?"

units.zh: 屋質曰：「太后若授永康王，順天合人，復何疑？」
units.en: Wuzhi said, "If Your Majesty invests Prince Yongkang, you will follow Heaven's will and the people's wish—what doubt remains?"
units.literal: Wuzhi said, "If the empress dowager invests Prince Yongkang, it accords with Heaven and with men—what further doubt is there?"

units.zh: 李胡厲聲曰：「我在，兀欲安得立！」
units.en: Li Hu cried out harshly, "While I live, how can Wuyu be enthroned!"
units.literal: Li Hu said in a harsh voice, "While I am here, how can Wuyu be enthroned!"

units.zh: 屋質曰：「禮有世嫡，不傳諸弟。
units.en: Wuzhi said, "Rites provide for succession by the direct heir; the throne is not passed to younger brothers.
units.literal: Wuzhi said, "Rites provide for succession by the direct heir; the throne is not passed to younger brothers.

units.zh: 昔嗣聖之立，尚以為非，況公暴戾殘忍，人多怨讟。
units.en: Even Sishheng's enthronement was widely deemed improper—how much more so yours, when you are violent and cruel and the people murmur against you.
units.literal: Even when Sishheng was enthroned in the past it was still thought wrong—how much more when you, sir, are violent, cruel, and harsh, and many resent and revile you.

units.zh: 萬口一辭，願立永康王，不可奪也。」
units.en: Every voice calls for Prince Yongkang's enthronement, and that wish cannot be denied."
units.literal: Ten thousand mouths speak as one in wishing to enthrone Prince Yongkang; this cannot be taken away."

units.zh: 太后顧李胡曰：「汝亦聞此言乎？
units.en: The empress dowager turned to Li Hu and said, "Have you heard this as well?
units.literal: The empress dowager turned to Li Hu and said, "Have you also heard these words?

units.zh: 汝實自為之！」
units.en: You have brought this on yourself!"
units.literal: You have brought this on yourself!"

units.zh: 乃許立永康。
units.en: She then agreed to enthrone Prince Yongkang.
units.literal: She then agreed to enthrone Yongkang.

units.zh: 帝謂屋質曰：「汝與朕屬尤近，何反助太后？」
units.en: The emperor said to Wuzhi, "You and I are close kin—why have you sided with the empress dowager?"
units.literal: The emperor said to Wuzhi, "You and I are especially close in kinship—why do you instead aid the empress dowager?"

units.zh: 屋質對曰：「臣以社稷至重，不可輕付，故如是耳。」
units.en: Wuzhi replied, "I hold the state above all else and would not see it lightly entrusted—that is why I acted as I did."
units.literal: Wuzhi replied, "Your servant holds the altars of state supremely important and they cannot be lightly entrusted; therefore it was thus."

units.zh: 上喜其忠。
units.en: The emperor was pleased with his loyalty.
units.literal: The emperor was pleased with his loyalty.

units.zh: 天祿二年，耶律天德、蕭翰謀反下獄，惕隱劉哥及其弟盆都結天德等為亂。
units.en: In the second year of Tianlu, Yelu Tiande and Xiao Han were imprisoned for plotting rebellion; the tiyin Liuge and his younger brother Pendu joined Tiande and others in a conspiracy.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianlu, Yelu Tiande and Xiao Han plotted rebellion and were imprisoned; the tiyin Liuge and his younger brother Pendu joined Tiande and others in disorder.

units.zh: 耶律石剌潛告屋質，屋質遽引入見，白其事。
units.en: Yelu Shila secretly informed Wuzhi, who at once brought him before the emperor and reported the plot.
units.literal: Yelu Shila secretly informed Wuzhi; Wuzhi hastily brought him in to an audience and reported the matter.

units.zh: 劉哥等不服，事遂寢。
units.en: Liuge and the others denied the charge, and the matter was dropped.
units.literal: Liuge and the others denied guilt, and the affair was dropped.

units.zh: 未幾，劉哥邀駕觀樗蒲，捧觴上壽，袖刃而進。
units.en: Before long Liuge invited the emperor to watch a game of chupu, raised a cup in toast, and advanced with a blade hidden in his sleeve.
units.literal: Before long, Liuge invited the emperor to watch chestnut-burr gambling, raised a cup to offer longevity, and advanced with a blade hidden in his sleeve.

units.zh: 帝覺，命執之，親詰其事。
units.en: The emperor sensed danger, ordered him seized, and questioned him personally.
units.literal: The emperor perceived it, ordered him seized, and personally interrogated him about the affair.

units.zh: 劉哥自誓，帝復不問。
units.en: Liuge swore his innocence, and the emperor again let the matter drop.
units.literal: Liuge swore by himself, and the emperor again did not pursue it.

units.zh: 屋質奏曰：「當使劉哥與石剌對狀，不可輒恕。」
units.en: Wuzhi memorialized, "Liuge and Shila must confront each other in testimony; he must not be pardoned lightly."
units.literal: Wuzhi memorialized, saying, "Liuge and Shila should be made to confront each other in testimony; he must not be lightly pardoned."

units.zh: 帝曰：「卿為朕鞫之。」
units.en: The emperor said, "You shall investigate this for me."
units.literal: The emperor said, "You shall try the case for me."

units.zh: 屋質率劍士往訊之，天德等伏罪。
units.en: Wuzhi led armed guards to question them, and Tiande and the others confessed.
units.literal: Wuzhi led swordsmen to interrogate them, and Tiande and the others confessed guilt.

units.zh: 誅天德，杖翰，遷劉哥，以盆都使轄戛斯國。
units.en: Tiande was executed, Han was flogged, Liuge was transferred, and Pendu was sent as envoy to the Kirghiz.
units.literal: Tiande was executed, Han was beaten with the staff, Liuge was transferred, and Pendu was sent as envoy to the Kirghiz.

units.zh: 三年，表列泰寧王察割陰謀事，上不聽。
units.en: In the third year he submitted a memorial detailing the secret plots of Prince Taining Chage, but the emperor would not listen.
units.literal: In the third year he memorialized listing the secret plots of Prince Taining Chage, but the emperor would not heed it.

units.zh: 五年，為右皮室詳穩。
units.en: In the fifth year he was appointed you pishi xiangwen.
units.literal: In the fifth year he became you pishi xiangwen.

units.zh: 秋，上祭讓國皇帝於行宮，與群臣皆醉，察割弒帝。
units.en: That autumn the emperor sacrificed to the Yielding-the-Realm Emperor at the traveling palace; he and all his ministers were drunk when Chage assassinated him.
units.literal: In autumn the emperor sacrificed to the Yielding-the-Realm Emperor at the traveling palace; he and all the ministers were drunk, and Chage assassinated the emperor.

units.zh: 屋質聞有言「衣紫者不可失」，乃易衣而出，亟遣人召諸王，乃喻禁衛長皮室等同力討賊。
units.en: Wuzhi heard someone say, "Do not lose the man in purple," changed his clothes and went out, urgently sent men to summon the princes, and urged the guard commander and the pishi to join in suppressing the rebels.
units.literal: Wuzhi heard someone say, "One dressed in purple must not be lost," so he changed clothes and went out, urgently sent men to summon the princes, and instructed the commander of the guard and the pishi and others to join forces to suppress the rebels.

units.zh: 時壽安王歸帳，屋質遣弟沖迎之。
units.en: Prince Shou'an was then returning to his tent, and Wuzhi sent his younger brother Chong to meet him.
units.literal: At that time Prince Shou'an was returning to his tent; Wuzhi sent his younger brother Chong to welcome him.

units.zh: 王至，尚猶豫。
units.en: When the prince arrived he still hesitated.
units.literal: When the prince arrived, he was still hesitant.

units.zh: 屋質曰：「大王嗣聖子，賊若得之，必不容。
units.en: Wuzhi said, "Your Highness is a son of Emperor Sisheng; if the rebels seize you, they will not spare you.
units.literal: Wuzhi said, "The great king is a son of Sishheng; if the rebels get you, they will surely not spare you.

units.zh: 群臣將誰事，社稷將誰賴？
units.en: Whom will the ministers then serve, and on whom will the realm rely?
units.literal: Whom will the ministers then serve, and on whom will the altars of state rely?

units.zh: 萬一落賊手，悔將何及？」
units.en: If you fall into their hands, what regret will suffice?"
units.literal: If by chance you fall into the rebels' hands, what regret will be enough?"

units.zh: 王始悟。
units.en: The prince then understood.
units.literal: The prince then understood.

units.zh: 諸將聞屋質出，相繼而至。
units.en: When the generals heard that Wuzhi had emerged, they came one after another.
units.literal: The generals, hearing that Wuzhi had come out, arrived one after another.

units.zh: 遲明整兵，出賊不意，圍之，遂誅察割。
units.en: At dawn they marshaled the troops, caught the rebels off guard, surrounded them, and executed Chage.
units.literal: At dawn they arrayed the troops, took the rebels unawares, surrounded them, and thereupon executed Chage.

units.zh: 亂既平，穆宗即位，謂屋質曰：「朕之性命，實出卿手。」
units.en: Once order was restored, Emperor Muzong took the throne and said to Wuzhi, "I owe my life to you."
units.literal: When the disorder was settled, Muzong took the throne and said to Wuzhi, "My life in truth came from your hand."

units.zh: 命知國事，以逆黨財產盡賜之，屋質固辭。
units.en: He appointed Wuzhi to oversee state affairs and offered him all the rebels' property, but Wuzhi firmly declined.
units.literal: He appointed him to manage state affairs and bestowed on him all the property of the rebel faction; Wuzhi firmly declined.

units.zh: 應歷五年，為北院大王，總山西事。
units.en: In the fifth year of Yingli he was made great king of the Northern Court with authority over the western territories.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Yingli he became great king of the Northern Court and oversaw affairs west of the mountains.

units.zh: 保寧初，宋圍太原，以屋質率兵往援，至白馬嶺，遣勁卒夜出間道，疾馳駐太原西，鳴鼓舉火。
units.en: Early in the Baoning era, when Song besieged Taiyuan, Wuzhi led troops to relieve the city; at White Horse Ridge he sent crack troops by night along a hidden path to gallop west of Taiyuan, beating drums and raising fires.
units.literal: Early in the Baoning era, when Song besieged Taiyuan, Wuzhi was sent with troops to relieve the city; reaching White Horse Ridge, he dispatched crack troops by night along a hidden path to gallop swiftly and halt west of Taiyuan, beating drums and raising fires.

units.zh: 宋兵以為大軍至，懼而宵遁。
units.en: The Song army thought the main force had arrived, panicked, and fled overnight.
units.literal: The Song army thought a great host had arrived, feared it, and fled by night.

units.zh: 以功加於越。
units.en: For this service he was promoted to yuyue.
units.literal: For his merit he was advanced to yuyue.

units.zh: 四年，漢劉繼元遣使來貢，致幣於屋質，屋質以聞，帝命受之。
units.en: In the fourth year Liu Jiyuan of Northern Han sent envoys with tribute and offered gifts to Wuzhi; Wuzhi reported the matter, and the emperor ordered the gifts accepted.
units.literal: In the fourth year, Liu Jiyuan of Han sent envoys to present tribute and offered gifts to Wuzhi; Wuzhi reported this, and the emperor ordered the gifts accepted.

units.zh: 五年五月薨，年五十七。
units.en: He died in the fifth month of the fifth year, aged fifty-seven.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year he died, aged fifty-seven.

units.zh: 帝痛悼，輟朝三日。
units.en: The emperor grieved deeply and suspended court for three days.
units.literal: The emperor grieved deeply and suspended court for three days.

units.zh: 後道宗詔上京立祠祭享，樹碑以紀其功雲。
units.en: Later Emperor Daozong ordered a shrine built at the Upper Capital for sacrificial offerings and a stele erected to commemorate his achievements.
units.literal: Later Emperor Daozong ordered a shrine erected at the Upper Capital for sacrificial offerings and a stele set up to record his achievements.

units.zh: 耶律吼，字曷魯，六院部夷離堇蒲古只之後。
units.en: Yelu Hou, whose courtesy name was Helu, was a descendant of Puguzhi, yilijin of the Six Courts tribes.
units.literal: Yelu Hou, courtesy name Helu, was a descendant of Puguzhi, yilijin of the Six Courts tribes.

units.zh: 端愨好施，不事生產。
units.en: He was upright and generous, cared nothing for accumulating wealth, and did not trouble himself with farming or trade.
units.literal: He was upright and sincere, fond of giving, and did not attend to production.

units.zh: 太宗特加倚任。
units.en: Emperor Taizong placed exceptional trust in him.
units.literal: Taizong especially added trust and reliance on him.

units.zh: 會同六年，為南院大王，蒞事清簡，人不敢以年少易之。
units.en: In the sixth year of Huitong he was made great king of the Southern Court; his administration was clear and unassuming, and none dared underestimate him for his youth.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Huitong he became great king of the Southern Court; his handling of affairs was clear and simple, and people did not dare treat him lightly because of his youth.

units.zh: 時晉主石重貴表不稱臣，辭多踞慢，吼言晉罪不可不伐。
units.en: At that time the Jin ruler Shi Chonggui sent a memorial in which he refused to style himself a subject; his language was openly arrogant. Hou argued that Jin's offense could not go unanswered by war.
units.literal: At that time the Jin ruler Shi Chonggui in his memorial did not style himself a subject; the wording was largely arrogant and disrespectful. Hou said that Jin's crime could not go unpunished.

units.zh: 及帝親征，以所部兵從。
units.en: When the emperor marched in person, Hou accompanied him with the troops under his command.
units.literal: When the emperor campaigned in person, he followed with the troops under his command.

units.zh: 既入汴，諸將皆取內帑珍異，吼獨取馬鎧，帝嘉之。
units.en: After the army entered Bian, the other generals seized rare treasures from the imperial storehouse; Hou took only horse armor, and the emperor commended him.
units.literal: After they entered Bian, all the generals took rare treasures from the inner treasury; Hou alone took horse armor, and the emperor praised him.

units.zh: 及帝崩於欒城，無遺詔，軍中憂懼不知所為。
units.en: When the emperor died at Luancheng without a final testament, the army was gripped by fear and uncertainty.
units.literal: When the emperor died at Luancheng there was no dying command; the army was anxious and fearful and did not know what to do.

units.zh: 吼詣北院大王耶律窪議曰：「天位不可一日曠。
units.en: Hou went to Yelu Wa, great king of the Northern Court, and said, "The throne cannot stand vacant even for a day.
units.literal: Hou went to the great king of the Northern Court, Yelu Wa, to discuss and said, "The throne cannot stand vacant for a single day.

units.zh: 若請於太后，則必屬李胡。
units.en: If we consult the empress dowager, the succession will surely go to Li Hu.
units.literal: If we ask the empress dowager, the succession will surely fall to Li Hu.

units.zh: 李胡暴戾殘忍，詎能子民。
units.en: Li Hu is violent and cruel—how could he rule as a true sovereign over the people?
units.literal: Li Hu is violent, cruel, and harsh—how could he be a father to the people?

units.zh: 必欲厭人望。
units.en: If you mean to satisfy the people's hopes,
units.literal: If one must satisfy the people's hopes,

units.zh: 則當立永康王。」
units.en: then Prince Yongkang should be enthroned."
units.literal: then one should enthrone Prince Yongkang."

units.zh: 窪然之。
units.en: Wa agreed.
units.literal: Wa approved.

units.zh: 會耶律安摶來，意與吼合，遂定議立永康王，是為世宗。
units.en: Yelu Antuan then arrived with the same view as Hou, and together they resolved to enthrone Prince Yongkang, who became Emperor Shizong.
units.literal: It happened that Yelu Antuan arrived; his intent agreed with Hou's, and they thereupon settled on enthroning Prince Yongkang, who became Shizong.

units.zh: 頃之，以功加采訪使，賜以寶貨。
units.en: Soon afterward he was promoted to investigative commissioner for his service and rewarded with precious goods.
units.literal: Shortly thereafter, for his merit he was made additional investigative commissioner and bestowed precious goods.

units.zh: 吼辭曰：「臣位已高，敢復求富！
units.en: Hou declined, saying, "My rank is already high—how dare I seek more wealth!
units.literal: Hou declined, saying, "Your servant's rank is already high—how dare he seek wealth again!

units.zh: 臣從弟的錄諸子坐事籍沒，陛下哀而出之，則臣受賜多矣。」
units.en: My younger cousin Dilu and his sons were seized and their property confiscated for their offenses; if Your Majesty in mercy releases them, I will have received more than enough."
units.literal: Your servant's younger cousin Dilu and his sons were confiscated for their offenses; if Your Majesty in pity releases them, your servant will have received ample favor."

units.zh: 上曰：「吼舍重賞，以族人為請，其賢遠甚。」
units.en: The emperor said, "Hou has forgone a rich reward to plead for his kin—his virtue stands far above the common run."
units.literal: The emperor said, "Hou forgoes heavy reward to plead for his clansmen—his worth is far greater."

units.zh: 許之，仍賜宮戶五十。
units.en: He granted the request and still bestowed fifty palace households.
units.literal: He granted it and moreover bestowed fifty palace households.

units.zh: 時有取當世名流作《七賢傳》者，吼與其一。
units.en: Someone then compiled a Biographies of the Seven Worthies from the leading men of the age, and Hou was counted among them.
units.literal: At that time someone compiled a Biographies of the Seven Worthies from celebrated men of the age, and Hou was numbered among them.

units.zh: 天祿三年卒，年三十九。
units.en: He died in the third year of Tianlu at the age of thirty-nine.
units.literal: He died in the third year of Tianlu, aged thirty-nine.

units.zh: 子何魯不。
units.en: His son was Helubu.
units.literal: His son was Helubu.

units.zh: 何魯不，字斜寧，嘗與耶律屋質平察割亂。
units.en: Helubu, whose courtesy name was Xiening, once joined Yelu Wuzhi in suppressing Chage's rebellion.
units.literal: Helubu, courtesy name Xiening, once joined Yelu Wuzhi in suppressing Chage's rebellion.

units.zh: 穆宗以其父吼首議立世宗，故不顯用。
units.en: Because Muzong knew his father Hou had led the plan to enthrone Shizong, he did not give him prominent office.
units.literal: Because Muzong knew his father Hou had been foremost in planning to enthrone Shizong, he did not employ him prominently.

units.zh: 晚年為本族敞史。
units.en: In his later years he served as changshi of his own tribe.
units.literal: In his later years he served as changshi of his own tribe.

units.zh: 及景宗即位，以平察割功，授昭德軍節度使，為北院大王。
units.en: When Emperor Jingzong took the throne, for his service in suppressing Chage he was appointed Zhaode Army military commissioner and made great king of the Northern Court.
units.literal: When Jingzong took the throne, for his merit in suppressing Chage he was made Zhaode Army military commissioner and great king of the Northern Court.

units.zh: 時黃龍府軍將燕頗殺守臣以叛，何魯不討之，破於鴨淥江。
units.en: When Yan Yan, a garrison officer of Huanglong Prefecture, killed the defending official and rebelled, Helubu campaigned against him and defeated him on the Yalu River.
units.literal: At that time Yan Yan, a garrison officer of Huanglong Prefecture, killed the defending official and rebelled; Helubu campaigned against him and defeated him on the Yalu River.

units.zh: 坐不親追擊，以至失賊，杖之。
units.en: Because he failed to pursue in person and let the rebels escape, he was flogged.
units.literal: Because he did not pursue in person, the rebels escaped; he was beaten with the staff.

units.zh: 乾亨間卒。
units.en: He died during the Qianheng era.
units.literal: He died during the Qianheng era.

units.zh: 耶律安摶，曾祖巖木，玄祖之長子。
units.en: Yelu Antuan's great-grandfather Yanmu was the eldest son of the mysterious ancestor.
units.literal: Yelu Antuan's great-grandfather was Yanmu, eldest son of the mysterious ancestor.

units.zh: 祖楚不魯，為本部夷離堇。
units.en: His grandfather Chubulu served as yilijin of their tribe.
units.literal: His grandfather Chubulu served as yilijin of the native tribe.

units.zh: 父叠裏，幼多疾，時太祖為撻馬狘沙裏，常加撫育。
units.en: His father Dieli was often ill as a child; Taizu, then serving as tamaxie shali, frequently cared for him.
units.literal: His father Dieli suffered many illnesses in youth; at that time Taizu was tamaxie shali and often gave him care and nurture.

units.zh: 神冊六年，為惕隱，從太祖將龍軍討阻卜、党項有功。
units.en: In the sixth year of Shence he became tiyin and followed Taizu at the head of the Dragon Army against the Zubu and Tangut, earning distinction.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Shence he became tiyin and followed Taizu leading the Dragon Army to campaign against the Zubu and Tangut with merit.

units.zh: 天贊三年，為南院夷離堇，征渤海，攻忽汗城，俘斬甚眾。
units.en: In the third year of Tianzan he became yilijin of the Southern Court, campaigned against Bohai, attacked Huhan city, and took or killed a great many of the enemy.
units.literal: In the third year of Tianzan he became yilijin of the Southern Court, campaigned against Bohai, attacked Huhan city, and captured and slew a great many.

units.zh: 太祖崩，淳欽皇后稱制，欲以大元帥嗣位。
units.en: After Taizu died, Empress Chunqin assumed regency and wished to enthrone the great marshal.
units.literal: When Taizu died, Empress Chunqin assumed regency and wished the great marshal to succeed to the throne.

units.zh: 叠裏建言，帝位宣先嫡長；
units.en: Dieli advised that the throne should pass first to the eldest son of the direct line;
units.literal: Dieli offered counsel that the imperial seat should go first to the direct eldest heir;

units.zh: 今東丹王赴朝，當立。
units.en: and that the Prince of Eastern Dan, now coming to court, should be enthroned.
units.literal: now the Prince of Eastern Dan is coming to court and ought to be enthroned.

units.zh: 由是忤旨。
units.en: This brought him into conflict with the regent's will.
units.literal: Because of this he offended the imperial will.

units.zh: 以黨附東丹王，詔下獄，訊鞫，加以炮烙。
units.en: Accused of siding with the Prince of Eastern Dan, he was imprisoned by edict, interrogated, and tortured with branding irons.
units.literal: On the charge of factionally supporting the Prince of Eastern Dan, an edict sent him to prison; he was interrogated and tortured with branding.

units.zh: 不伏，殺之，籍其家。
units.en: He would not confess and was executed; his property was confiscated.
units.literal: He would not confess; they killed him and confiscated his household.

units.zh: 安摶自幼若成人，居父喪，哀毀過禮，見者傷之。
units.en: From childhood Antuan behaved like a grown man; in mourning his father he grieved beyond the prescribed rites, and all who saw him were deeply moved.
units.literal: Antuan from childhood was like an adult; in mourning for his father his grief and emaciation exceeded the rites, and those who saw it were moved to sorrow.

units.zh: 太宗屢加慰諭，嘗曰：「此兒必為令器。」
units.en: Emperor Taizong comforted him repeatedly and once said, "This boy will surely prove a man of great promise."
units.literal: Taizong repeatedly comforted and instructed him and once said, "This boy will surely become a fine vessel."

units.zh: 既長，寡言笑，重然諾，動遵繩矩，事母至孝。
units.en: When he grew up he was sparing of speech and laughter, kept his promises, conducted himself by strict rule, and served his mother with the utmost filial devotion.
units.literal: When grown he spoke and laughed little, valued his word, in action followed the measuring line, and served his mother with utmost filial piety.

units.zh: 以父死非罪，未葬，不預宴樂。
units.en: Because his father had died unjustly and remained unburied, he refused all feasts and entertainments.
units.literal: Because his father had died though guilty of no crime and was not yet buried, he did not take part in feasts or music.

units.zh: 世宗在藩邸，尤加憐恤，安摶密自結納。
units.en: While Shizong was still at his princely residence he showed Antuan especial kindness, and Antuan secretly pledged himself to him.
units.literal: When Shizong was at the princely residence he showed him especial pity and care, and Antuan secretly attached himself to him.

units.zh: 太宗伐晉還，至欒城崩，諸將欲立世宗，以李胡及壽安王在朝，猶豫未決。
units.en: When Taizong died at Luancheng on his return from the Jin campaign, the generals wished to enthrone Shizong, but with Li Hu and Prince Shou'an still at court they hesitated.
units.literal: When Taizong returned from campaigning against Jin and died at Luancheng, the generals wished to enthrone Shizong, but because Li Hu and Prince Shou'an were at court they hesitated and could not decide.

units.zh: 時安摶直宿衛，世宗密召問計。
units.en: Antuan was then on palace guard duty; Shizong secretly summoned him to ask his counsel.
units.literal: At that time Antuan was on palace guard duty; Shizong secretly summoned him to ask his plan.

units.zh: 安摶曰：「大王聰安寬恕，人皇王之嫡長；
units.en: Antuan said, "Your Highness is wise, calm, and magnanimous, the eldest son of Emperor Ren by the direct line;
units.literal: Antuan said, "The great king is intelligent, peaceful, and forgiving, the direct eldest son of Emperor Ren;

units.zh: 先帝雖有壽安，天下屬意多在大王。
units.en: though the late emperor also had Prince Shou'an, the realm's hopes rest chiefly on Your Highness.
units.literal: though the late emperor also had Shou'an, the realm's hopes lie mostly with the great king.

units.zh: 今若不斷，後悔無及。」
units.en: If you do not act now, you will regret it when it is too late."
units.literal: If you do not decide now, regret will come too late."

units.zh: 會有自京師來者，安摶詐以李胡死傳報軍中，皆以為信。
units.en: When someone arrived from the capital, Antuan falsely spread word through the army that Li Hu was dead, and all believed it.
units.literal: It happened that someone came from the capital; Antuan falsely spread word in the army that Li Hu was dead, and all believed it.

units.zh: 於是安摶詣北、南二大王計之。
units.en: Antuan then went to the great kings of the Northern and Southern Courts to consult them.
units.literal: Thereupon Antuan went to the great kings of the Northern and Southern Courts to plan together.

units.zh: 北院大王窪聞而遽起曰：「吾二人方議此事。
units.en: Wa, great king of the Northern Court, rose at once and said, "We two were just discussing this very matter.
units.literal: The great king of the Northern Court, Wa, on hearing this rose hastily and said, "We two were just discussing this matter.

units.zh: 先帝嘗欲以永康王為儲貳，今日之事，有我輩在，孰敢不從！
units.en: The late emperor once wished to make Prince Yongkang heir apparent; with us here today, who would dare refuse!
units.literal: The late emperor once wished to make Prince Yongkang heir apparent; in today's affair, with us here, who would dare not follow!

units.zh: 但恐不白太后而立，為國家啟釁。」
units.en: Yet I fear that enthroning him without informing the empress dowager will sow strife for the realm."
units.literal: Yet I fear that enthroning him without informing the empress dowager will open strife for the state."

units.zh: 安摶對曰：「大王既知先帝欲以永康王為儲副，況永康王賢明，人心樂附。
units.en: Antuan replied, "Your Highness already knows the late emperor wished Prince Yongkang as heir; moreover he is worthy and wise, and the people are eager to follow him.
units.literal: Antuan replied, "The great king already knows the late emperor wished Prince Yongkang as heir designate; moreover Prince Yongkang is worthy and wise, and men's hearts gladly attach to him.

units.zh: 今天下甫定，稍緩則大事去矣。
units.en: The realm has only just been settled; hesitate even briefly and the opportunity will be lost.
units.literal: The realm has just been settled; delay even slightly and the great affair will be lost.

units.zh: 若白太后，必立李胡。
units.en: If we inform the empress dowager, she will surely enthrone Li Hu.
units.literal: If we inform the empress dowager, she will surely enthrone Li Hu.

units.zh: 且李胡殘暴，行路共知，果嗣位，如社稷何？」
units.en: Moreover Li Hu's cruelty is known to everyone on the road; if he truly succeeds, what will become of the realm?"
units.literal: Moreover Li Hu is cruel and violent—travelers all know it; if he truly succeeds, what of the altars of state?"

units.zh: 南院大王吼曰：「此言是也。
units.en: Hou, great king of the Southern Court, said, "He is right.
units.literal: The great king of the Southern Court, Hou, said, "These words are right.

units.zh: 吾計決矣！」
units.en: My mind is made up!"
units.literal: My plan is settled!"

units.zh: 乃整軍，召諸將奉世宗即位於太宗柩前。
units.en: They marshaled the army, summoned the generals, and enthroned Shizong before Taizong's bier.
units.literal: They then arrayed the army, summoned the generals, and enthroned Shizong before Taizong's bier.

units.zh: 帝立，以安摶為腹心，總知宿衛。
units.en: Once enthroned, the emperor made Antuan his closest confidant and placed him in overall charge of the palace guard.
units.literal: When the emperor was established, he made Antuan his intimate confidant and put him in overall charge of palace guard.

units.zh: 是歲，約和於潢河橫渡。
units.en: That year peace was concluded at Huanghe Ford Crossing.
units.literal: That year peace was agreed at Huanghe Ford Crossing.

units.zh: 太后問安摶曰：「吾與汝有何隙？」
units.en: The empress dowager asked Antuan, "What grievance lies between us?"
units.literal: The empress dowager asked Antuan, "What rift is there between me and you?"

units.zh: 安摶以父死為對，太后默然。
units.en: Antuan answered by citing his father's death; the empress dowager said nothing.
units.literal: Antuan answered with his father's death; the empress dowager fell silent.

units.zh: 及置北院樞密使，上命安摶為之，賜奴婢百口，寵任無比，事皆取決焉。
units.en: When the Northern Court commissioner of military affairs was established, the emperor appointed Antuan to the post, granted him a hundred servants, favored him beyond any other, and left all major decisions to him.
units.literal: When the Northern Court commissioner of military affairs was established, the emperor appointed Antuan to the post, bestowed a hundred male and female servants, favored and entrusted him beyond compare, and all affairs were decided by him.

units.zh: 然性太寬，事循茍簡，豪猾縱恣不能制。
units.en: Yet he was excessively lenient, handled affairs in a lax and perfunctory way, and could not restrain the powerful and unscrupulous.
units.literal: Yet his nature was too lenient; in affairs he followed lax simplicity and could not restrain the powerful and cunning who ran wild.

units.zh: 天祿末，察割兵犯禦幄，又不能討，由是中外短之。
units.en: Late in the Tianlu period Chage's troops breached the imperial quarters and he failed to suppress them; court and country alike faulted him for it.
units.literal: At the end of Tianlu, Chage's troops violated the imperial quarters, and he could not suppress them; because of this court and country found fault with him.

units.zh: 穆宗即位，以立世宗之故，不復委用。
units.en: When Emperor Muzong took the throne, because Antuan had helped enthrone Shizong he was no longer given office.
units.literal: When Muzong took the throne, because of his role in enthroning Shizong he was no longer entrusted with office.

units.zh: 應歷三年，或誣安摶與齊王罨撒葛謀亂，系獄死。
units.en: In the third year of Yingli he was falsely accused of plotting rebellion with Prince Qi Yansage, imprisoned, and died in custody.
units.literal: In the third year of Yingli someone falsely accused Antuan of plotting rebellion with Prince Qi Yansage; he was imprisoned and died.

units.zh: 侄撒給，左皮室詳穩。
units.en: His nephew Sagie served as zuo pishi xiangwen.
units.literal: His nephew Sagie was zuo pishi xiangwen.

units.zh: 耶律窪，字敵輦，隋國王釋魯孫，南院夷離堇綰思子。
units.en: Yelu Wa, whose courtesy name was Dirilian, was grandson of Prince of Sui Shilu and son of Southern Court yilijin Wansi.
units.literal: Yelu Wa, courtesy name Dirilian, was grandson of Prince of Sui Shilu and son of yilijin Wansi of the Southern Court.

units.zh: 少有器識，人以公輔期之。
units.en: From youth he showed foresight and judgment, and people expected him to reach high office.
units.literal: From youth he had capacity and insight, and people looked to him for high office.

units.zh: 太祖時，雖未官，常任以事。
units.en: Under Taizu, though he held no formal office, he was often entrusted with important affairs.
units.literal: During Taizu's time, though without office, he was often entrusted with affairs.

units.zh: 太宗即位，為惕隱。
units.en: When Emperor Taizong took the throne, he was made tiyin.
units.literal: When Taizong took the throne, he became tiyin.

units.zh: 天顯末，帝援河東，窪為先鋒，敗張敬達軍於太原北。
units.en: Late in the Tianxian era the emperor marched to aid Hedong; Wa served as vanguard and defeated Zhang Jingda's army north of Taiyuan.
units.literal: Late in the Tianxian era the emperor aided Hedong; Wa served as vanguard and defeated Zhang Jingda's army north of Taiyuan.

units.zh: 會同中，遷北院大王。
units.en: During the Huitong period he was transferred to great king of the Northern Court.
units.literal: During Huitong he was transferred to great king of the Northern Court.

units.zh: 及伐晉，復為先鋒，與梁漢璋戰於瀛州，敗之。
units.en: When the army campaigned against Jin he again served as vanguard, fought Liang Hanzhang at Yingzhou, and defeated him.
units.literal: When they campaigned against Jin he again served as vanguard, fought Liang Hanzhang at Yingzhou, and defeated him.

units.zh: 太宗崩於欒城，南方州郡多叛，士馬困乏，軍中不知所為。
units.en: When Emperor Taizong died at Luancheng, many southern prefectures rebelled; troops and horses were exhausted, and the army was at a loss.
units.literal: When Taizong died at Luancheng, many southern prefectures and districts rebelled; troops and horses were exhausted, and the army did not know what to do.

units.zh: 窪與耶律吼定策立世宗，乃令諸將曰：「大行上賓，神器無主，永康王人皇王之嫡長，天人所屬，當立；
units.en: Wa and Yelu Hou resolved to enthrone Shizong, then told the generals, "The late emperor has departed; the throne stands vacant. Prince Yongkang is the direct eldest son of Emperor Ren and Heaven's chosen heir—he should be enthroned;
units.literal: Wa and Yelu Hou settled on a plan to enthrone Shizong, then ordered the generals, saying, "The late emperor has ascended as guest; the regalia of state has no master. Prince Yongkang is the direct eldest son of Emperor Ren and the choice of Heaven and men—he should be enthroned;

units.zh: 有不從者，以軍法從事。」
units.en: whoever refuses will be dealt with by military law."
units.literal: whoever does not obey will be dealt with by military law."

units.zh: 諸將皆曰：「諾。」
units.en: The generals all answered, "Yes."
units.literal: The generals all said, "Yes."

units.zh: 世宗即位，賜宮戶五十，拜於越。
units.en: When Emperor Shizong took the throne, he granted Wa fifty palace households and invested him as yuyue.
units.literal: When Shizong took the throne, he granted fifty palace households and invested him as yuyue.

units.zh: 卒，年五十四。
units.en: He died at the age of fifty-four.
units.literal: He died, aged fifty-four.

units.zh: 耶律頹昱，字團寧，孟父楚國王之後。
units.en: Yelu Tuiyu, whose courtesy name was Tuanning, was a descendant of the Mengfu Prince of Chu.
units.literal: Yelu Tuiyu, courtesy name Tuanning, was a descendant of the Mengfu Prince of Chu.

units.zh: 父末掇，嘗為夷離堇。
units.en: His father Moduo had once served as yilijin.
units.literal: His father Moduo once served as yilijin.

units.zh: 頹昱性端直。
units.en: Tuiyu was upright and forthright by nature.
units.literal: Tuiyu's nature was upright and direct.

units.zh: 會同中，領九石烈部，政濟寬猛。
units.en: During the Huitong period he led the Nine Shilie tribes and governed with a balance of leniency and severity.
units.literal: During Huitong he led the Nine Shilie tribes; his governance balanced leniency and severity.

units.zh: 世宗即位，為惕隱。
units.en: When Emperor Shizong took the throne, he was made tiyin.
units.literal: When Shizong took the throne, he became tiyin.

units.zh: 天祿三年，兼政事令，封漆水郡王。
units.en: In the third year of Tianlu he was made concurrent chief administrator and enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui commandery.
units.literal: In the third year of Tianlu he was made concurrent chief administrator and enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui commandery.

units.zh: 及穆宗立，以匡贊功，嘗許以本部大王。
units.en: When Emperor Muzong took the throne, for his service in supporting the enthronement he was once promised the great kingship of his tribe.
units.literal: When Muzong took the throne, for his merit in supporting the enthronement he was once promised the great kingship of his tribe.

units.zh: 後將葬世宗，頹昱懇言於帝曰：「臣蒙先帝厚恩，未能報；
units.en: Later, when Shizong was to be buried, Tuiyu earnestly said to the emperor, "I received great favor from the late emperor and have been unable to repay it;
units.literal: Later, when Shizong was to be buried, Tuiyu earnestly said to the emperor, "Your servant received great favor from the late emperor and has been unable to repay it;

units.zh: 幸及大葬，臣請陪位。」
units.en: now that the state funeral is at hand, I ask to take part in the rites."
units.literal: now that the great burial has come, your servant asks to take part in the rites."

units.zh: 帝由是不悅，寢其議。
units.en: The emperor was displeased and set the proposal aside.
units.literal: The emperor was displeased by this and set the proposal aside.

units.zh: 薨。
units.en: He died.
units.literal: He died.

units.zh: 耶律撻烈，字涅魯袞，六院部郎君甗古直之後。
units.en: Yelu Talie, whose courtesy name was Nielugun, was a descendant of Langjun Enguzhi of the Six Courts tribes.
units.literal: Yelu Talie, courtesy name Nielugun, was a descendant of Langjun Enguzhi of the Six Courts tribes.

units.zh: 沈厚多智，有任重才。
units.en: He was deep, steady, and resourceful, with talent fit for heavy responsibility.
units.literal: He was deep, steady, and resourceful, with talent fit for heavy responsibility.

units.zh: 年四十未仕。
units.en: He reached forty without taking office.
units.literal: He reached forty without taking office.

units.zh: 會同間，為邊部令穩。
units.en: During the Huitong period he served as lingwen of a frontier tribe.
units.literal: During Huitong he served as lingwen of a frontier tribe.

units.zh: 應歷初，升南院大王，均賦役，勸耕稼，部人化之，戶口豐殖。
units.en: Early in the Yingli period he was promoted to great king of the Southern Court; he equalized levies and corvée, encouraged farming, and the people of his tribe were transformed until households multiplied.
units.literal: Early in Yingli he was promoted to great king of the Southern Court; he equalized levies and corvée, encouraged farming, and the people of his tribe were transformed—households multiplied.

units.zh: 時周人侵漢，以撻烈都統西南道軍援之。
units.en: When Zhou invaded Han, Talie was made overall commander of the Southwest Route army to relieve it.
units.literal: At that time Zhou invaded Han, and Talie was made overall commander of the Southwest Route army to relieve it.

units.zh: 周已下太原數城，漢人不敢戰。
units.en: Zhou had already taken several cities around Taiyuan, and the Han forces did not dare give battle.
units.literal: Zhou had already taken several cities around Taiyuan, and the Han forces did not dare fight.

units.zh: 及聞撻烈兵至，周主遣郭從義、尚鈞等率精騎拒於忻口。
units.en: When word came that Talie's army had arrived, the Zhou ruler sent Guo Congyi, Shang Jun, and others with elite cavalry to oppose him at Xinkou.
units.literal: When they heard Talie's army had arrived, the Zhou ruler sent Guo Congyi, Shang Jun, and others with crack cavalry to oppose him at Xinkou.

units.zh: 撻烈擊敗之，獲其將史彥超，周軍遁歸，復所陷城邑，漢主詣撻烈謝。
units.en: Talie defeated them, captured their general Shi Yanchao, the Zhou army fled, the lost cities were recovered, and the Han ruler came in person to thank him.
units.literal: Talie defeated them, captured their general Shi Yanchao, the Zhou army fled back, the lost cities were recovered, and the Han ruler came to thank Talie.

units.zh: 及漢主殂，宋師來伐，上命撻烈為行軍都統，發諸道兵救之。
units.en: After the Han ruler died, Song forces invaded; the emperor ordered Talie to serve as campaign commander-in-chief and mobilize troops from all routes to relieve them.
units.literal: When the Han ruler died, Song forces came to attack; the emperor ordered Talie to serve as campaign commander-in-chief and mobilize troops from all routes to relieve them.

units.zh: 既出雁門，宋諜知而退。
units.en: Once he marched out through Yanmen Pass, Song scouts learned of it and withdrew.
units.literal: Once he had marched out through Yanmen, Song scouts learned of it and withdrew.

units.zh: 保寧元年，加兼政事令，致政。
units.en: In the first year of Baoning he was made additional concurrent chief administrator and retired from office.
units.literal: In the first year of Baoning he was made additional concurrent chief administrator and retired from office.

units.zh: 乾亨初，召之。
units.en: Early in the Qianheng period he was summoned to court.
units.literal: Early in Qianheng he was summoned.

units.zh: 上見鬚髮皓然，精力猶健，問以政事，厚禮之。
units.en: The emperor saw that his beard and hair were white but his vigor remained strong; he questioned him on state affairs and treated him with great honor.
units.literal: The emperor saw his beard and hair were white but his vigor was still strong; he questioned him on state affairs and treated him with great honor.

units.zh: 以疾薨，年七十九。
units.en: He died of illness at the age of seventy-nine.
units.literal: He died of illness, aged seventy-nine.

units.zh: 撻烈凡用兵，賞罰信明，得士卒心。
units.en: In all his campaigns Talie made rewards and punishments clear and reliable, and won the loyalty of his troops.
units.literal: Whenever Talie employed troops, rewards and punishments were trusted and clear, and he won the hearts of officers and men.

units.zh: 河東單弱，不為周、宋所並者，撻烈有力焉。
units.en: Hedong stood alone and weak; that Zhou and Song did not absorb it owed much to Talie's efforts.
units.literal: Hedong was isolated and weak; that it was not absorbed by Zhou and Song owed much to Talie's strength.

units.zh: 在治所不修邊幅，百姓無稱，年谷屢稔。
units.en: At his post he cared nothing for personal appearance and won no praise from the people, yet harvests under his rule were repeatedly abundant.
units.literal: At his seat of government he did not trim his appearance; the common people had no praise for him, yet the year's grain was repeatedly abundant.

units.zh: 時耶律屋質居北院，撻烈居南院，俱有政跡，朝議以為「富民大王」云。
units.en: At that time Yelu Wuzhi governed the Northern Court and Talie the Southern Court; both left records of sound administration, and the court called them the "kings who enrich the people."
units.literal: At that time Yelu Wuzhi held the Northern Court and Talie the Southern Court; both had records of good governance, and court opinion called them the "kings who enrich the people."

units.zh: 贊曰：立嗣以嫡，禮也。
units.en: The encomium says: Establishing an heir by the direct line is ritual propriety.
units.literal: The encomium says: To establish an heir by the direct line is ritual propriety.

units.zh: 太宗崩，非安摶、吼、窪謀而克斷，策立世宗，非屋質直而能諫，杜太后之私，折李胡之暴，以成橫渡之約，則亂將誰定？
units.en: When Taizong died, had Antuan, Hou, and Wa not schemed with firm resolve to enthrone Shizong; had Wuzhi not been upright and able to remonstrate, checking the empress dowager's partiality and breaking Li Hu's violence to complete the peace at the ford crossing—who would have ended the chaos?
units.literal: When Taizong died, had not Antuan, Hou, and Wa schemed with decisive judgment and planned to enthrone Shizong; had not Wuzhi been upright and able to remonstrate, blocking the empress dowager's partiality and breaking Li Hu's violence to complete the agreement at the ford crossing—who would have settled the disorder?

units.zh: 四臣者，庶幾《春秋》首止之功哉。
units.en: These four ministers approach, one might say, the achievement of "first stopping" praised in the Spring and Autumn Annals.
units.literal: These four ministers approach, one might say, the achievement of "first stopping" in the Spring and Autumn Annals.
